title: Undirected edge weight identity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$, and let $x,y\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The undirected stable hypercube edge weight between $x$ and $y$ equals twice the directed stable hypercube edge weight from $x$ to $y$.
